compute_operation_bound.crypto_io_count_bound: 100 asset downloads and 100 decryptions only if separately authorized; no new broker requests
compute_operation_bound.derivation: Per identity-entry at most 2*28+2*25+2*25+2*25+36=242 window-key checks across source/horizon templates; at most 12 fixed Boolean/index operations per key plus fewer than 1000 shared counters/reductions. 4000 bounds 242*12+1000=3904. Cross-sectional context reductions are cached per identity-entry, not identity-pair enumerations. JSON/crypto/I/O and generic graph traversal are separately bounded, not disguised as scalar predicates.
compute_operation_bound.graph_complexity: O(V+I) connected components via incidence hypergraph traversal; no O(V^2) adjacency expansion
compute_operation_bound.incidence_upper_bound: At most 100*N*G incidence references with shared context/date hyperedges; use compact bitmaps and interval-compressed incidences, not dense edges
compute_operation_bound.plaintext_byte_bound_reason: Not derivable from encrypted inventory metadata; future adapter must use streaming projection and bounded shard lifecycle, and report concrete resource feasibility before execution

future_adapter_architecture.compute: After plaintext discarded, masks alone derive windows, peer counts, coverage and factorized overlap graph. All potential peers are read; no per-identity pair scan required.
future_adapter_architecture.decrypt: One accepted envelope at a time on already established private machine route. Verify public SPKI, plaintext canonical hash, exact identities/segments/schema; discard plaintext immediately after validity projection. Do not reuse old screen ARM or launch old acquisition workflow.
future_adapter_architecture.download: Separately authorized GitHub release adapter only; verify IDs/size/encrypted SHA and accepted manifest before each shard; no broker imports/routes
future_adapter_architecture.fail_closed: Stop on hash/schema/duplicate identity provenance/drift, protected-forward or extra-data ingress. Missing market rows yield mask reasons, not data repair requests.
future_adapter_architecture.storage: Persist only masks/provenance and aggregates, never raw/decrypted rows or feature/response numeric values
future_adapter_architecture.three_valued_causal_masks: Absent original availability authority yields UNKNOWN for causal certification while geometric support can be reported separately; no synthetic timestamp substitution
future_adapter_architecture.validity_projection: One pass through canonical rows creates source identity-time bitmaps for presence/uniqueness, OHLC consistency, nonnegative counts, positive OPEN/CLOSE and optional authenticated availability provenance; no logarithm, aggregate price location, normalization or future return calculation

minimum_next_permission: Independent audit of frozen protocol; separate explicit support-only execution authorization required before downloads/decryption/rows

overlap_graph.bar_incidence_edge: Two nodes adjacent iff query readsets share an identity-time key, or declared shared-calendar/context incidence hyperedge connects them. Same timestamp alone does not make a missing economic-link authority.
overlap_graph.connected_components: Report component count/size and date coverage by layer; connected components are not certified independent samples
overlap_graph.context_hyperedge: (context,t,role) links same-context potential peer-B mask queries and frozen peer-response queries. Factorize by context snapshots; do not materialize dense identity-pair edges.
overlap_graph.exact_overlap_geometry: Store factorized sorted key/date/context incidence sufficient to reproduce all edges, components and no-overlap classes without prices
overlap_graph.nodes: (source,identity,t,horizon) potential and complete-mask event nodes; separate geometric, causal-certified and causal-unknown layers
overlap_graph.required_query_readset: All feature/B required identity-M5 keys, including absent-key queries that determine missingness. Response mask queries cover own future keys plus every frozen fresh peer future key, including invalid responses.
overlap_graph.shared_calendar_hyperedge: For every UTC date touched by any required feature/B/response query, attach node to that global date hyperedge, across all identities and contexts. Cross-midnight nodes attach to all touched dates; never cut edges at segment boundary.

required_outputs.dependence_cluster_geometry: Factorized incidence/overlap graph and connected-component geometry derived from masks only, not score dependence/correlation
required_outputs.effective_calendar_support: For each candidate/horizon/layer: number and set of distinct UTC entry dates with >=1 complete joint event, unique entry slots and touched dates; descriptive effective calendar coverage only, never ESS, independent N or power
required_outputs.mask_artifact: No prices, counts-as-feature, logs, realized feature/response values, return sign/magnitude or economic metrics; output fixed bool/tri-state bitmaps, identity/context/time keys, cardinalities and reason codes only
required_outputs.peer_masks: Per cross-sectional identity-entry: fresh peer cardinality and frozen peer-set provenance; per horizon valid response subset cardinality; UNKNOWN causal peers remain separately recorded
required_outputs.per_context_support_counts: Aggregate identical identity-event counters plus distinct entry timestamp union; distinguish sums of identity-events from unique calendar support; retain all29 contexts including zero structural support
required_outputs.per_identity_support_counts: For every candidate/horizon/eligible identity: scheduled potential events, geometrically complete, causal PASS/FALSE/UNKNOWN, complete response-mask events and complete joint events per causal layer; report each failure reason and combinations
required_outputs.temporal_coverage_summary: Full inherited archive domain: per-day and per-segment counters, first/last complete entry timestamp, longest run of consecutive scheduled complete entry slots, gap histogram in scheduled slots, left/right censor counts; no best period/subset selection

shared_calendar_block_unit.cross_day_dependence: Preserve readset/date hyperedges across dates; no day-independence claim
shared_calendar_block_unit.reason: Calendar reporting/dependence bookkeeping only; does not select inferential block length or estimate correlations

source_domain.entry_grid: t in [start,end) on M5 UTC grid for four sources; hour grid for regime. Warmup/right censoring are masks, not arbitrary trimming. Include incomplete events in reason denominators.
